message.content: {"draft":"Hypothesis: the 1M-element shape is DRAM-bound; the prior 1024-wide block underutilizes L2/occupancy. Observed contradiction: candidate already beats torch.compile 3x there, so only a larger, fully-masked vector width can widen the geometric mean. Coordinate check: flat offset i maps to x[i],y[i],out[i]; edge i=n-1 masked when n%BLOCK!=0.","plan":"Output shape equals input shape; contiguous stride 1, so flat offset = linear index. Padded lanes load 0.0 and are masked on store. Actual width = min(BLOCK, n). Cast x,y to FP32, compute sigmoid, multiply, store once (tl.store casts to out dtype). Allocate fresh contiguous out via empty_like; inputs untouched.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def silu_mul_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = offsets < n_elements","    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)","    y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)","    sig = tl.sigmoid(x)","    out = x * sig * y","    tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, out, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and y.is_cuda","    assert x.shape == y.shape","    assert x.is_contiguous() and y.is_contiguous()","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","    n = out.numel()","    if n == 0:","        return out","    if n <= 4096:","        block = 256","    elif n <= 65536:","        block = 1024","    else:","        block = 2048","    grid = lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(n, meta['BLOCK_SIZE']),)","    silu_mul_kernel[grid](x, y, out, n, BLOCK_SIZE=block)","    return out"]}
